    lower = grid[divider + 1:]

    return [

def transform(grid):
    """Mark cells where the two panels share the same color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(cell == 4 for cell in row)), None)

    base = next(iter(shared))
